question: 我家 8 岁的孩子最近晚上总醒，可以照你给成人的夜醒建议做吗？

retrieved_evidence.title: CDC · About Sleep
retrieved_evidence.text: CDC lists at least seven hours of daily sleep as a general recommendation for adults aged 18–60. Sleep needs vary with age; this section does not state recommendations for other ages. This is a general daily reference, not a personalized diagnosis.

retrieved_evidence.title: NIH/NHLBI ? Insomnia Symptoms
retrieved_evidence.scope: Symptom context; no awakening-count diagnostic cutoff
retrieved_evidence.text: Frequent nighttime waking, difficulty staying asleep, or waking early without being able to return to sleep can occur with insomnia. Feeling unrefreshed, daytime sleepiness and difficulty concentrating also matter. An awakening count alone does not establish a diagnosis; this page gives no universal normal-count cutoff.

retrieved_evidence.title: NIH/NHLBI · Healthy Sleep Habits
retrieved_evidence.scope: Adult sleep habits and shift-work guidance
retrieved_evidence.text: Allow enough time for sleep. Keep bedtime and waking time consistent; NHLBI suggests limiting weekday–weekend differences to about one hour.

retrieved_evidence.title: NIH/NHLBI · Insomnia Treatment
retrieved_evidence.scope: Insomnia treatment education; no individualized prescription
retrieved_evidence.text: Stimulus control links bed with sleep: go to bed when sleepy, leave bed if unable to sleep, and return when sleepy. Use bed for sleep rather than prolonged wakeful activities. This is one component of CBT-I, not proof of a diagnosis.

repairs.candidate:
不建议直接照搬成人的夜醒建议。我查到的资料里，成人时长参考只适用于 18–60 岁，明确不覆盖 8 岁儿童；夜醒相关的资料也没有给出适用于儿童的“正常次数”标准，所以成人那套判断和调整方式不能直接套到孩子身上。[H1:AdultDuration][H8:NightWaking]

能通用的一点是：单看“醒了几次”不足以说明问题，还要看孩子醒后能否自己再睡着、白天是否困倦或注意力下降、是否影响情绪和学习。如果夜醒频繁并持续影响白天状态，或伴随打鼾、呼吸不畅等情况，建议找儿科或儿童睡眠专科评估，而不是按成人方案自行调整。[H8:NightWaking]

如果只是想做些温和的日常调整，可以先固定作息：每天上床和起床时间尽量一致，周末与工作日的差异控制在一小时左右，并保证孩子有足够的睡眠时间；这些是成人资料中的一般作息原则，用在儿童身上属于合理的生活习惯，但仍需按孩子的年龄和学校安排来定。[H2:Schedule]

另外，我这边只有 P01 的成人睡眠记录，没有你孩子的睡眠数据，因此无法判断他夜醒的具体频率是否异常。如果你愿意，可以告诉我孩子大概每晚醒几次、醒后多久能再睡着，我可以帮你梳理哪些情况更值得记录并带给医生。
